resources.string: Where the calendar\'s holidays and school vacations come from
The public holidays and school vacations on the calendar are built into the app, so nothing is downloaded while you use it. They were prepared from the sources below.
School vacations for Slovakia, Austria and each German state. Contains information from OpenHolidays API data, which is made available under the Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0.
The public holidays for Slovakia, Germany, Austria and Russia were checked against it, date by date. © Vacanza Team and contributors, MIT licence.
Czech public holidays and school vacations are calculated by the app itself.
